# Security Checklist: ISK-0006 — Host Composition & DI Registration

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for configuration isolation from the host, coexistence without global ownership, request isolation, value-free diagnostics, and the authentication boundary are complete, clear, and consistent
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Configuration Isolation

- [x] CHK001 - Is it stated which host services Iskender never reads, and that it never changes the host's configuration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Registration 3]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the environment-name rule stated so that a host's own `Development` can never relax Iskender's production defaults? [Clarity, Spec §TR-3, §US2-6, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 - Is `ISKENDER__` reading opt-in, with the observable result when the host does not opt in? [Measurability, Spec §TR-2, §US2-7]
- [x] CHK004 - Is it stated that code-built values reach Iskender only as documents, with no extra precedence layer? [Clarity, Spec §TR-4, Contract §Registration 4]

## Coexistence

- [x] CHK005 - Are the global items Iskender must not add listed exhaustively, consistently between spec and contract? [Consistency, Spec §TR-8, §FR-014, Contract §Coexistence 1]
- [x] CHK006 - Is it stated that a request outside every prefix runs no Iskender code, and how that is observable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, §US3-3]
- [x] CHK007 - Are overlapping and root prefixes defined, including the known limit for `/`? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Coexistence 4, §Known limits]
- [x] CHK008 - Is SC-004's comparison defined: what is compared, what is excluded, and what counts as a change? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Research R17]

## Request Isolation

- [x] CHK009 - Is the correlation rule for a caller value defined with its header, length, and character set, and is the gateway ID stated as authoritative? [Clarity, Contract §Route group 3, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 - Is one context per request stated, with a measurable concurrent-request criterion? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, §US4-3, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the request deadline's source and bounds defined, as configuration rather than code? [Completeness, Spec §TR-14, Contract §Configuration]

## Value-Free Diagnostics

- [x] CHK012 - Is the set of values that must never appear in an event, exception, diagnostic, or response stated identically in each place it appears? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §SC-005, Contract §Diagnostics 2]
- [x] CHK013 - Are the canaries, and the outputs searched for them, defined precisely enough to measure "0 times"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Research R16]
- [x] CHK014 - Is it stated that an unreadable document or a failing stream factory is reported without its content or exception text? [Completeness, Contract §Start-up 4, §Known limits "Stream factories"]
- [x] CHK015 - Is every event template defined, with each placeholder's possible values, so none can carry a configuration value? [Clarity, Contract §Diagnostics 1, Research R16]

## Authentication Boundary and Threats

- [x] CHK016 - Is it stated where mandatory authentication will attach, so host middleware cannot remove or replace it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Route group 6]
- [x] CHK017 - Is it explicit that this spec adds no authentication scheme, and that the route group answers only with the 404 envelope until ingress specs add endpoints? [Clarity, Spec §Overview, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK018 - Does each row of the Negative Security and Failure Scenarios table map to a requirement and to a contract rule? [Traceability, Spec §Negative Security and Failure Scenarios, Contract §Threat model]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the exception to "registration opens no connection", the single-instance guard at host start, stated consistently wherever inertness is required? [Consistency, Spec §Negative Security table, §FR-013a, Contract §Start-up 6.2]
- [x] CHK020 - Are credentials kept out of composition, with the behavior when no credential provider is registered stated? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Research R4, Contract §Registration 8]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
